about: 1.9: sentences each summary word list must match, and must not (the text review's false matches among them). Written for the test, not taken from any summary. A case's show has its category's genres (genresAll and the first of genresAny) unless it names its own, and a length, network and years its rule allows. Census.Tests runs every case, and the app's TextWords must say the same of each (a throwaway check, see HANDOFF).
